rules.description: Fund 5-Year Rolling Return Average must exceed Benchmark Average

rules.label: Sharpe Ratio
rules.description: Fund Sharpe Ratio must exceed Benchmark Sharpe Ratio

result.fundName: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund - Growth Plan - Direct Plan

insights: HDFC Balanced Advantage Fund - Growth Plan - Direct Plan decisively outperforms its benchmark on rolling returns by 7.71% (18.38% vs 10.67%).
Chance of beating benchmark is 67.1% — moderate consistency, below the 70% Golden Triangle threshold.
Sharpe ratio is near parity (0.64 vs 0.49) — similar risk-adjusted efficiency.
Aggressive profile: beta 1.42 with 14.9% annualised volatility vs benchmark 9.1%.
Positive alpha of 3.14% suggests manager skill beyond market exposure (info ratio 0.60).
Drawdown protection: max drawdown -34.20% vs benchmark -18.85% — shallower losses in downturns.
Rolling return range spans -27.42% to 76.36% (103.78 pp spread) — consistency score 80.
Failed criteria: Chance of Beating Benchmark.
